Actress Hayden Panettiere Dies at 36; Career and Personal Life Recalled

Actress Hayden Panettiere, known for her roles in "Heroes" and "Nashville," died on Sunday at the age of 36. Her ex-partner, former heavyweight boxing champion Wladimir Klitschko, stated he is in "profound shock and grief" following her death. Various outlets have published tributes and career retrospectives, with some also revisiting past personal struggles and interviews.
